offering_description.value: DXP supplies pumps, replacement parts, and maintenance, repair, and operations supplies to industrial plants and water utilities through its service centers. It engineers and fabricates packaged pumping systems and provides pump repair and field service. It also manages procurement and inventory at customer sites.

primary_products.value: Industrial pumps and parts; bearings and power transmission components; safety supplies; metalworking tools; engineered pumping systems

primary_services.value: Pump repair and remanufacturing; field maintenance; pumping system engineering and installation; on-site procurement and inventory management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial plant operators, oil and gas producers, manufacturers, and engineering contractors; B2G: Municipal water and wastewater utilities

end_markets.value: Oil and gas; industrial manufacturing; chemical processing; water and wastewater; food and beverage processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Pumps, replacement parts, and industrial maintenance supplies; project or contract: Custom pumping packages and contracted on-site procurement and inventory programs; service fees: Pump repair, remanufacturing, and field maintenance
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources industrial equipment and supplies from manufacturers for plants, contractors, and utilities; OEM / manufacturer: Integrates purchased pumps, drives, and controls into custom packages for industrial operators and utilities; service provider: Repairs customer equipment and manages purchased supplies and inventory for industrial plants

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Canada, with operations in the United Arab Emirates

specialization.value: related lines: Industrial supplies, engineered pumping systems, equipment repair, and on-site supply chain management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Industrial account teams and applications engineers; own locations: Company-operated service centers and branches; other: On-site supply programs at customer facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Fabrication, repair, and field work are subject to workplace safety and environmental rules, including OSHA standards.
